# RF-Lab firmware component.
#
# The Web UI is a single gzip-compressed HTML file generated by
# tools/build_web.py (run automatically by scripts/embed_web.py before build).
# It is embedded into the app image, so there is no LittleFS/SPIFFS partition.
file(GLOB app_sources "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.c")

# web_ui_gz.S is generated by scripts/embed_web.py before CMake configures
# (uses .incbin with an absolute path); EMBED_FILES is avoided because its
# generated .S path breaks under PlatformIO's relative BUILD_DIR.
idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${app_sources} "web/web_ui_gz.S"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES esp_http_client
)
